title: Japanese Noble Salmon
description: Pan-seared salmon with a Japanese-inspired curry sauce, served with steamed rice.
instructions: 1. Rinse the salmon fillets and pat dry with paper towels.
2. In a small saucepan, melt 1 tbsp of Canadian butter over medium heat.
3. Add 1 tsp of curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
4. Add 1 cup of water to the saucepan and bring to a simmer.
5. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 5 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
6. Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
7. Add the remaining 1 tbsp of Canadian butter to a large skillet over medium-high heat.
8. Sear the salmon fillets for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
9. Serve the salmon with steamed rice and spoon the curry sauce over the top.
